modification: Primary request: a gentle page-turning reading pose. Turn three-quarter toward viewer-right, holding the original open book in one supporting hand slightly to one side at waist/chest height. With the other hand delicately pinch and lift ONE page corner midway through turning, showing a curved cream page and an anatomically clear hand. Eyes follow the page with a focused small smile, head tilted slightly. Keep her whole body standing and both shoes visible. No quill or hand tool; no legible page text. The changing page and asymmetrical arms should create a visibly different silhouette from studious two-hand reading.
